forest-deep.description: Principal dark brand ground for the hero, trust, philosophy, and partnership chapters.

forest.description: Interactive tint and compact icon background on light surfaces.

forest-soft.description: Radial illumination and tonal lift inside deep forest fields.

gold.description: Core accent for numerals, rules, progress, active navigation, bullets, and primary actions.

gold-bright.description: High-contrast gold for dark-surface labels, focus rings, shimmer, and icon detail.

gold-deep.description: Strong accent on light surfaces, including icons, hover states, dots, and controls.

gold-text.description: Small gold copy and field labels on cream surfaces.

components.name: Gold Button
components.description: Primary action on both forest and cream chapters.
components.css: .ds-btn-gold { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 3.25rem; padding: 0.75rem 1.85rem; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; color: var(--color-ink); background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-gold-bright), var(--color-gold)); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.4s var(--ease-lux), filter 0.55s var(--ease-out); } .ds-btn-gold:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-gold:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-gold-bright); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-gold:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.99); }

components.name: Glass Button
components.description: Secondary action over dark imagery and forest fields.
components.css: .ds-btn-glass { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 3.25rem; padding: 0.75rem 1.85rem; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; color: var(--color-cream); background: rgba(247, 242, 232, 0.05); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 0.5px rgba(255,255,255,0.09); backdrop-filter: blur(7px) saturate(125%); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.4s var(--ease-lux), background 0.55s var(--ease-out); } .ds-btn-glass:hover { background: rgba(247, 242, 232, 0.12); } .ds-btn-glass:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-gold-bright); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-glass:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.99); }

components.name: Underlined Field
components.description: Transparent editorial field used by the enquiry form.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; position: relative; color: var(--color-ink); font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-field::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset-inline: 0; bottom: 0; height: 1px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-gold) 25%, transparent); } .ds-field::before { content: ""; position: absolute; z-index: 1; inset-inline: 0; bottom: 0; height: 1px; background: var(--color-gold); transform: scaleX(0); transition: transform 0.5s ease-out; } .ds-field:focus-within::before { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-field-label { display: block; color: var(--color-gold-text); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.14em; transition: color 0.3s; } .ds-field:focus-within .ds-field-label { color: var(--color-gold-deep); } .ds-field-input { width: 100%; padding: 0.5rem 0 0.625rem; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink); font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 1.25rem; } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-ink) 30%, transparent); }

components.name: Desktop Navigation Link
components.description: Serif section link for the forest-state fixed header.
components.html: Smart maskCatalog
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1.75rem; padding: 1rem 1.5rem; background: var(--color-forest-deep); } .ds-nav-link { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-cream) 80%, transparent); font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 1rem; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.3s; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link-active { color: var(--color-gold); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-gold-bright); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Glass Language Chip
components.description: Compact language switcher and icon-control material.
components.css: .ds-glass-chip { display: inline-flex; min-height: 2.75rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.375rem; padding: 0 0.875rem; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; color: var(--color-cream); background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 8%, transparent); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 22%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(7px) saturate(125%); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s, color 0.3s; } .ds-glass-chip:hover { color: var(--color-gold); background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 16%, transparent); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 40%, transparent); } .ds-glass-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-gold-bright); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Catalog Card
components.description: Flat product-set card defined by image fade, gold hairline, and a rounded silhouette.
components.html:
Combination Package

Face and body care together.
components.css: .ds-catalog-card { width: 15rem; overflow: hidden; border-radius: var(--radius-card); background: var(--color-cream-soft); color: var(--color-ink); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-gold) 35%, transparent); } .ds-catalog-art { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-cream), var(--color-gold-bright)); } .ds-catalog-art h3 { position: absolute; inset-inline: 1rem; bottom: 0.75rem; z-index: 1; margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-catalog-fade { position: absolute; inset-inline: 0; bottom: 0; height: 60%; background: linear-gradient(to top, var(--color-cream-soft), color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-cream-soft) 70%, transparent), transparent); } .ds-catalog-copy { min-height: 4.5rem; padding: 1rem; border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-gold) 25%, transparent); color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-ink) 65%, transparent); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.625; } .ds-catalog-card:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--color-gold-deep); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Product Hotspot
components.description: Signature 44px product annotation with a cream-glass label and pulsing gold dot.
components.css: @keyframes ds-hotspot-ping { 0% { opacity: 0.7; transform: scale(1); } 70%, 100% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(2.9); } } .ds-hotspot-wrap { display: inline-flex; position: relative; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; padding-top: 2rem; } .ds-hotspot-label { position: absolute; top: 0; white-space: nowrap; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-cream) 80%, transparent); color: var(--color-ink); box-shadow: 0 4px 14px -5px rgba(58,46,22,0.45); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-hotspot { position: relative; display: flex; width: 2.75rem; height: 2.75rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; } .ds-hotspot-ping { position: absolute; width: 1rem; height: 1rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-gold) 70%, transparent); animation: ds-hotspot-ping 2.4s var(--ease-out) infinite; } .ds-hotspot-dot { position: relative; width: 1rem; height: 1rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-gold-deep); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-cream) 85%, transparent); transition: background 0.3s; } .ds-hotspot:hover .ds-hotspot-dot { background: var(--color-gold); } .ds-hotspot:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-gold-deep); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-hotspot-ping { animation: none; opacity: 0; } }

components.name: FAQ Row
components.description: Border-only editorial accordion row with a rotating antique-gold plus.
components.css: .ds-faq-row { display: flex; width: 100%; min-height: 2.75rem; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1.5rem; padding: 1.25rem 0; border: 0; border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-gold) 25%, transparent); border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-gold) 25%, transparent); background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink); font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 1.25rem; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-faq-plus { color: var(--color-gold-deep); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 300; transition: transform 0.3s; } .ds-faq-row[aria-expanded="true"] .ds-faq-plus { transform: rotate(45deg); } .ds-faq-row:hover { color: var(--color-gold-text); } .ds-faq-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-gold-deep); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
Yishu Malaysia reproduces the established Yishu world as a long-form luxury editorial: dark forest fields and warm cream paper alternate in broad chapters, while restrained gold rules, serif display type, and product imagery carry the brand. The system feels botanical, ceremonial, and technically assured rather than clinical or conventionally cosmetic.

The page is spacious and image-led. Dense information is organized through split layouts, ruled lists, comparison grids, and calm typographic hierarchy instead of boxed dashboard patterns. Glass appears only on small interactive layers; shimmer, glints, reveal motion, and soft background light add polish without displacing the content.
keyCharacteristics: Alternating forest, ink, cream, and cream-soft sections create the page's chapter rhythm.
Oranienbaum supplies the editorial voice; Commissioner carries readable explanatory and interface copy.
Gold is structural as well as decorative: it marks hierarchy, focus, rules, progress, and primary actions.
Full-bleed reference imagery dissolves into sections through gradients, masks, and tonal overlays.
Motion is slow, eased, and ornamental, with a complete reduced-motion fallback.

rules.name: The Gold Has a Job Rule
rules.body: Gold marks hierarchy, interaction, evidence, or a deliberate gleam; it is not a blanket fill for large content areas.

rules.name: The Alternating Chapters Rule
rules.body: Preserve the implemented dark/light section rhythm so a long page remains legible and recognizably Yishu.

rules.name: The Readable Gold Rule
rules.body: Use `gold-text` for small gold text on cream and `gold-bright` for small gold text on dark backgrounds.

rules.name: The Serif Leads Rule
rules.body: Headings, names, numerals, navigation, and field values use the display family; paragraphs, labels, and operational copy use the sans family.

rules.name: The Wordmark Exception Rule
rules.body: Italic display treatment belongs to the Yishu name and inline brand mentions, not to every heading.

rules.name: The One Container Rule
rules.body: Full-bleed color and imagery belong to section backgrounds; readable content aligns to the shared 80rem container.

rules.name: The Mobile Recomposition Rule
rules.body: Complex desktop grids must become intentional sequences or scrollers, never squeezed miniature versions.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Use tone, rules, and image fades before reaching for a shadow.

rules.name: The Small Glass Rule
rules.body: Backdrop blur belongs on compact overlays and controls, never across a large scrolling content field.

rules.name: The Curves and Rules Rule
rules.body: Reserve curves for objects and actions; use straight lines for information structure.

dos: Do preserve the dark forest / warm cream chapter rhythm and the reference imagery's tonal integration.
Do use the shared 80rem container, 1.25rem-to-2rem page gutters, and the 4px spacing rhythm.
Do use gold rules, masks, and gradients to integrate images and organize dense information.
Do keep interactive hit areas at least 44px and preserve visible gold focus treatment.
Do provide equivalent focus behavior for hover reveals and disable shimmer, ping, parallax, reveal, and bar animation under reduced motion.
Do keep English, Simplified Chinese, and Bahasa Melayu routes visually consistent; font fallbacks may change, hierarchy must not.
donts: Don't replace the editorial layout with generic boxed cards, dashboard chrome, or an unrelated regional redesign.
Don't use the core `gold` token for small text on cream; use `gold-text` there.
Don't add large blurred surfaces or decorative shadows where a tonal change or gold hairline already supplies separation.
Don't round inputs, ingredient tiles, or comparison grids into pills and cards; their straight rules are part of the visual grammar.
Don't animate without the existing luxury easing and reduced-motion fallback.
Don't introduce imagery that sits as a hard rectangle when the surrounding chapter uses fades, masks, or tonal overlays.
